consensus_summary: Fans generally agree that the 1992-03-17 show at The Spectrum was lackluster, with many describing it as one of the worst performances they had witnessed. Jerry Garcia's limited vocal contributions and the overall low energy from the band contributed to a disappointing experience for attendees.
